request.description: Start `elide run` (or `elide test`) with `--debugger=dap` and connect to it.

program.description: JavaScript, TypeScript or Python file, or manifest script name, relative to cwd. Omit to run the project's default entrypoint.

args.description: Arguments after `program`. Without `program`, these are passed to the Elide subcommand as-is.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the worktree root.

command.description: Elide subcommand: `run` a program or debug `test`s.

elideArgs.description: Elide flags placed before `program`, for example `["--max-mem=512m"]`.

flags.description: Build flags passed as repeated -f NAME[=VALUE].

options.description: CLI options: true emits a flag, false omits it, arrays repeat it. Debugger options are reserved; use host and port.

programArgs.description: Application arguments appended after --, separate from Elide options.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause before executing the program. Supported by Elide 1.6.3; older releases may always pause on entry.

host.description: IPv4 address for the DAP listener (`--debugger-host`). Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

port.description: Port for the DAP listener (`--debugger-port`). Defaults to a free port.

request.description: Connect to a program already started with `elide run --debugger=dap`.

host.description: IPv4 address of the DAP listener. `tcp_connection.host` takes precedence.

port.description: Port of the DAP listener. `tcp_connection.port` takes precedence.
